title: Host Hotels (HST) Q2 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
description: Host Hotels reported Q2 2024 revenue of $1.47 billion, up 5.2% year-over-year, and EPS of $0.57, up from $0.29 a year ago. The company's performance on key metrics like average room rate, RevPAR, and occupancy percentage was mixed compared to analyst estimates.

title: Host Hotels & Resorts Announces Third Quarter Dividend
description: Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. (HST) announced a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share, payable on October 15, 2024, to stockholders of record as of September 30, 2024.

title: Host Hotels & Resorts Announces Third Quarter 2024 Earnings Call to be Held on November 7, 2024
description: Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. (HST) will report its third quarter 2024 financial results on November 6, 2024, and hold a conference call on November 7, 2024, to discuss the results and business outlook.

title: Host Hotels & Resorts Announces Fourth Quarter Dividend and Special Dividend on Common Stock
description: Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. announced a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share and a special dividend of $0.10 per share, bringing the total dividends declared for the year to $0.90 per share.

title: Host Hotels & Resorts Announces Fourth Quarter 2024 Earnings Call to be Held on February 20, 2025
description: Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. (HST) will report its fourth quarter 2024 financial results on February 19, 2025, and hold a conference call on February 20, 2025. The company is the largest lodging real estate investment trust and one of the largest owners of luxury and upper-upscale hotels in the United States and internationally.
